stories.title: Tool Schema Contract Registry
stories.description: Define and centralize a registry mapping each allowlisted tool to its Pydantic schema and callable, enforcing a single source of truth for tool contracts.

stories.title: Deterministic Tool Dispatch Core Logic
stories.description: Implement deterministic routing logic that selects and invokes tools strictly from the allowlist registry, including argument parsing, schema binding, and execution sequencing.

stories.title: Tool Router Integration with FastAPI Endpoint
stories.description: Integrate tool routing into the FastAPI request lifecycle, ensuring tool_use blocks from the LLM are processed through the router and results are returned in the correct response structure.

stories.title: End-to-End Tool Execution Integration with Domain Services
stories.description: Connect routed tools to underlying domain services (provider search, clinical trials, consent, unknowns) ensuring validated inputs correctly invoke business logic and return structured outputs.

stories.title: Comprehensive Tool Router Test Coverage
stories.description: Expand unit and integration tests to cover allowlist enforcement, schema validation, dispatch success paths, and failure scenarios including malformed tool_use payloads.
